extraction_notes: [text-pass] The provided article is a theoretical study using first-principles calculations to investigate the properties of pure AgSbTe2. It does not report experimental doping data or measured thermoelectric properties for doped AgSbTe2 samples; it only references experimental data from other literature (Jovovic et al., Mohanraman et al., and Su et al.) for comparison with theoretical calculations. [figure-pass p1-5] The paper presents first-principles calculations for pure AgSbTe2. No doped samples were experimentally characterized in the provided pages. Thermoelectric properties shown in Fig. 2 are theoretical calculations based on different band gaps and carrier concentrations. [figure-pass p6-6] The provided text discusses theoretical calculations for AgSbTe2 but does not contain experimental thermoelectric property data for doped or co-doped AgSbTe2 samples, nor does it contain any plots of thermoelectric properties versus temperature.
